> *"Revenue grew... strong performance... improved... decreased... expanded"*

- **Tone:** Confident, achievement-oriented
- **Key positive signals:** "grew," "strong performance," "improved," "expanded"

- **Key positive signals:** All metrics show upward movement — users (+22%), NPS (+9 points), headcount growth
- **Negative signals:** None detected
- **Notable:** High R&D spend (20% of revenue) signals long-term investment confidence

---

#### 3. Outlook — 🟡 Cautiously Optimistic / Forward-Positive
> *"we expect... include launching... expanding... achieving"*

- **Key positive signals:** Revenue growth projection continues upward trend; strategic initiatives are innovation-focused
